description: The plot illustrates the massive activation value of the atten_output_gate across different layers, comparing four distinct components. The x-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the max activation value, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, and tick labels at intervals of 50. The four lines in the plot represent attn_output (blue dashed line), ffn_output (green dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The attn_output and ffn_output lines remain relatively stable until around layer 20, where attn_output increases to approximately 100 and ffn_output increases to around 150. The attn_residual and ffn_residual lines exhibit a gradual increase from layer 0 to 20, with values rising from around 10 to 250 and 380, respectively. Notably, ffn_residual reaches its highest value of 380 at layer 24, while attn_residual reaches 250 at the same layer. The plot shows a significant increase in activation values for attn_residual and ffn_residual towards the higher layer numbers.
